flavor_text.one_paragraph: At the 24-mile sim scale beastmen are ONE generic chaotic type: a fragile horde of mixed kin (orc, goblin, kobold, gnoll, ogre, troll and the rest) under a war-chief. The specific race distribution is intermingled per 6-mile sub-hex at the gameplay handoff (beastman_distribution.json), so chaotic players and NPC lords meet a varied frontier rather than monolithic 'orc land'. Stripped record per gdd-culture-catalog §5.3.
